verdict.rationale: vLLM ships a documented OpenAI-compatible API server (with Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support) covering completions, tool calling, structured outputs, and reasoning outputs, with dedicated docs pages for each feature, and community confirmation that the OpenAI-compatible API is usable and integrates with existing OpenAI clients. missing for 10: independent hands-on API integration case studies beyond a brief community mention, and no llms.txt/machine-readable API spec confirmed (probe shows 404).
